item.title: Watch: Hickey the hero as Kilbrittain claim All-Ireland junior glory
item.description: Mark Hickey's free in injury-time proved the difference as Kilbrittain (Cork) edged 13-man Easkey (Sligo) by 0-19 to 0-18 at Croke Park to claim the All-Ireland club junior hurling championship title.

item.title: O'Neill goal helps steer Kildare past Dubs to O'Byrne Cup final
item.description: Kildare will play Westmeath in the O'Byrne Cup final next Friday night after defeating Dublin by 1-22 to 1-13 at Cedral St Conleth's Park this evening.

item.title: Upperchurch-Drombane come out on top in extra time epic to claim All-Ireland club IHC crown
item.description: Upperchurch-Drombane (Tipperary) are All-Ireland club intermediate hurling champions after edging Tooreen (Mayo) by 4-20 to 2-24 in a thrilling final at Croke Park this evening.

item.title: Two-pointers fire Mayo past Rossies into Connacht FBD League final
item.description: Mayo will play Galway in the Connacht FBD Football League final after recording a 0-22 to 1-6 victory over Roscommon at Dr Hyde Park this afternoon.

item.title: Late Daly goal seals All-Ireland club JFC triumph for Ballymacelligott
item.description: Ballymacelligott (Kerry) landed the All-Ireland club junior football championship crown this afternoon thanks to a 1-16 to 0-13 win against Clogher Eire Og (Tyrone) at Croke Park.

item.title: Brosnan hits 1-15 as Kerry coast towards McGrath Cup final date with Cork
item.description: Tony Bronsnan struck for 1-15 as Kerry dealt Waterford a whopping 29-point defeat at Dr Crokes this afternoon to move into the McGrath Cup final.

item.title: Dublin and Galway to square off in Walsh Cup final
item.description: Dublin and Galway are set for a Walsh Cup final date next weekend after coming through their respective semi-finals in the Leinster pre-season competition this afternoon.

item.title: Monaghan to face Tyrone as McKenna Cup semi-finals set
item.description: Derry, Donegal, Monaghan and Tyroneare the last four teams standing the Dr McKenna Cup following this afternoon's results in the Ulster pre-season competition.

item.title: An Ghaeltacht see off Glenullin at Croker to secure All-Ireland club IFC crown
item.description: An Ghaeltacht (Kerry) are All-Ireland club intermediate football champions after a 0-12 to 0-6 win against Glenullin (Derry) at Croke Park this afternoon.
